context: Tests a concise status rewrite that leads with the outcome, preserves identifiers, counts, and unconfirmed test state, and ends with at most one next action. Six lines is a target, not a rigid format requirement.

checklist.name: First line answers what happened
checklist.description: The rewrite opens with the outcome (fix pushed / tests corrected, PR moving), not with process or preamble

checklist.name: Scannable facts
checklist.description: The rewrite makes outcomes, current state, and the next action easy to distinguish. Labeled bullets suit this status report, but equivalent concise structure is acceptable.

checklist.name: Concise rewrite
checklist.description: The rewrite aims for six lines or fewer without losing decision-relevant facts or uncertainty. A small justified overrun is acceptable; filler, repeated facts, or crowded unreadable lines are not.

checklist.name: Identifiers and counts kept
checklist.description: Commit 4f2a1c9, PR #212, 3 of 17 failing tests, the timezone-fixture cause, and the 14% bundle-size observation all survive

checklist.name: One next action, no offers
checklist.description: At most one next action (re-request review once CI is green) and no 'let me know if…' closing offer

checklist.name: Narration removed, uncertainty preserved
checklist.description: No 'rabbit hole', 'long story short', or other process narration remains. Remove empty optimism such as 'hopefully', while preserving that the suite is still running and its outcome is not yet known.

checklist.name: No adjectival padding
checklist.description: Facts carry numbers and identifiers, not adjectives like 'nicely' or 'interesting'
